properties.description: a_reasoning_summary_keeps_its_room_and_the_budget.rs::a_claim_bigger_than_the_budget_leaves_the_summary_and_says_what_it_needs: one ~7,000-character claim on six idealizations named past 80 characters. At budget_chars 6,000 reasoning_report must fit, return no claim, set next_offset 0 and page.claim_needs_budget_chars (named in page.reads), and cut no string outside the claims below 80 characters; at the budget it names the claim comes back whole within it.
properties.findings: On main 983811cae it FAILS: budget_chars 6,000 answered 13,534 characters (the claim kept whole, 25 summary fields cut). With the fix it passes, with a_reasoning_report_keeps_to_a_small_budget and a_reasoning_read_back_keeps_its_words_and_pages unchanged and passing (2026-10-27).
properties.name: A reasoning summary keeps its room, and the reply its budget
